decision: Close native libjpeg draft scaling as the exact 12MP decode-memory route for this frozen product fixture. Do not undershoot to the 6MP half-resolution draft and upsample, alter the target/source/runtime or start a full render as rescue.
interpretation: For the exact 4032x6048 JPEG, Pillow/libjpeg cannot choose its half-resolution 2016x3024 native scale without undershooting the 2828x4242 target, so it retains the complete source geometry.
The result closes only native decoder scaling for this exact 12MP tier. It does not measure render fidelity, latency or memory and does not close other materially different 12MP mechanisms.
The 1MP U4.5B scaled-decode pass and U4.5C session-warm pass remain unchanged.
corrections: A read-only precontract feasibility diagnostic observed that Pillow retained full geometry. It decoded no pixels and created no artifact. The later contract fixed the independently necessary nonundershoot, strictly-smaller and 12MP-ceiling gates, and both formal processes then ran from the committed audit without changing source, target, runtime or result handling.
claim_ceiling: Private Windows/Pillow exact-source 12MP JPEG native-draft feasibility only; no preview fidelity, render latency/memory, final export, generic ingress, arbitrary JPEG, device performance, calibrated stock response, product release or stock evidence.
